text.description_html:
Laurey 89013, Melrose Stainless Steel T-Bar Knob

The Satin Stainless Steel Melrose T-Knob is made out of stainless steel for a modern look. This Melrose Satin Stainless Steel 2 Inch Pull comes packaged with the mounting hardware. This cabinet knob is great for lightweight doors and drawers all over your home. Install them in your kitchen on cabinets, on your furniture flips, or even on your bathroom vanity.

This cabinet pull is part of the Laurey Melrose Collection.

Specifications and Features of the Laurey 89013 Melrose Satin Stainless Steel T-Knob:

  • Material: Stainless Steel
  • Finish: Satin Stainless Steel
  • Length: 2"
  • Projection: 1-1/4"
  • Packaged with 1" long #8-32 screw and 1-1/2" long #8-32 screw.

Sold Individually
